title: Immutable base library and catalog
description: Schema for the immutable base library, specialized catalog, composition rules, override rules, transfer rules, and extension rules. This is the contractual foundation for the skill selection strategy: base → catalog → composition → override → extension → RETAINED.

base_skills.description: Immutable base library skills. These are always preferred first.

catalog_patterns.description: Specialized catalog patterns. Preferred after base skills.

allowed.description: Whether composition of multiple skills is allowed.

max_composed.description: Maximum number of skills in a composition.

allowed_slots.description: Fields that may be overridden declaratively.

forbidden_slots.description: Fields that may never be overridden.

requires_acceptance.description: A skill transferred from another project must pass full acceptance in the destination.

acceptance_scope.description: Scope of acceptance required for transfers.

source_tracking.description: Whether the source project is tracked in provenance.

must_demonstrate_no_prior_layer.description: Creator must demonstrate that base, catalog, composition, and override do not apply before generating an extension.

fallback_on_failure.description: If no option is acceptable, the run is RETAINED.

limits.description: Known limits of this base skill.

scenarios.description: Scenario IDs that test this base skill. A base skill without at least one scenario is not selectable.

source.description: Origin of the skill: 'internal' for framework-native skills, otherwise the source_id of an entry in library/source-registry.json.

spec_version.description: Pinned specification version when the source is a versioned standard rather than a git repository. Exactly one of commit or spec_version must be present.

applicability.description: When this pattern applies to a project.

activation_criteria.description: Observable positive signals in a project that justify selecting this pattern. A pattern without observable activation criteria is not selectable.

limits.description: Known limits and non-goals of this pattern.

scenarios.description: Scenario IDs that test this pattern. A pattern without at least one scenario is not selectable.

source.description: Origin of the pattern: 'internal' for framework-native patterns, otherwise the source_id of an entry in library/source-registry.json.

spec_version.description: Pinned specification version when the source is a versioned standard rather than a git repository. Exactly one of commit or spec_version must be present.
